instructions: Run the auto-merge command exactly as printed: `gh pr merge 42 --repo owner/repo --match-head-commit abc123 --auto --merge`.
Only if GitHub reports that auto-merge is unavailable, run the plain merge fallback: `gh pr merge 42 --repo owner/repo --match-head-commit abc123 --merge`.

If any command above fails with `GraphQL: API rate limit already exceeded`, or the quota warning reports GraphQL quota exhausted, use REST instead (its quota is separate; this merges immediately): `gh api -X PUT repos/owner/repo/pulls/42/merge -f sha=abc123 -f merge_method=merge`.
Then iterate immediately with the same options until the PR merges or needs work.
